title: 7+ months of AI-assisted dev: our space 4X Imperium is in Steam Next Fest with a free demo
author: keaslenyt
selftext:
Imperium is a single-player, turn-based space 4X with real depth and a lot of polish. The free demo is in Steam Next Fest (Oct 19 to 26), and full release is planned for shortly after.



AI tools were used across the whole workflow, and I'm proud of it:

\- Code: Claude (Godot 4.5). Design, systems and balance are ours.

\- Art: GPT Image 2.5, then a lot of Photoshop.

\- Music: Suno. Sound effects: ElevenLabs.

\- The rival empires are algorithmic AI, not an LLM.



What kept it together over 7+ months:

\- A ticket tracker for every bug and design decision, so nothing lives only in chat history. Testers file there too.

\- Headless AI-vs-AI games in batches, because manual playtesting alone isn't enough volume to judge a balance change.

\- Real testers on a Steam beta branch since August.



AI gets you a lot of game fast. Depth that holds up over a game that runs for centuries is still design work.



Free demo: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4806180/Imperium/?utm\_source=reddit&utm\_medium=r\_aigamedev&utm\_campaign=nextfest\_trailer](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4806180/Imperium/?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=r_aigamedev&utm_campaign=nextfest_trailer)

comments.author: gentlekatie
comments.body:
Here is immediate reactions:   
Master of orion 2 modernized very cool!  
  
1. Species cards look good and interesting.  
2. Planet UI looks good.  
3. Research cards don't tell the user anything. Having to click on every tech individually to know what they do is not great.  UI on the left is visually uninteresting.  
4. ship design Ui at 0:37 visually very interesting, "ship designs" wire box ui on the right side is an ugly contrast with the rest of the ship design UI.  
5. cool effect with the ships rotating around the planet. But again that ui on the left is basic and ugly.  
6. The combat seems visually uninteresting and doesnt seem to allow the player to make any choices or feel any dopamine payoff. Maybe a Master of Orion 2 combat system or perhaps just more work on the visual payoff:  tech pay off (if i place shields i want to see them block damage. Maybe stage the combat as volleys at specific ranges (long ranged weapons shoot first, medium 2nd, short range 3rd but do the most damage etc).  
7. Galaxy map looks good.

Good work all in all you're getting close.

replies.author: keaslenyt
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback, much appreciated :)  
Try the demo, I feel like some of your comments are already addressed in game.
